column1: # The upstream vcon-dev datasets this corpus is built from, each pinned to one
# commit. tools/build.py fetches exactly these and refuses a checkout that is
# not at its pin or has local changes. Commits recorded 2026-10-09, the same
# pins sipnab's corpus test reads. License: the SPDX identifier of each
# repository's LICENSE file at that commit.
# fake-vcons and tadhack-2025 are left out: every container in both names its
# parties with gmail.com addresses and +1 phone numbers that were never checked
